result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

MEMO - March 2026 Close
To: Controller
From: David Murguia, Senior Accountant
Re: DE (Halvard Systems GmbH) Cash - Operating, GL 1000 - March 2026 bank reconciliation
Date: 2026-04-03

1. SUMMARY
The DE operating account did not agree at 2026-03-31: GL balance EUR 357,376.36 vs. bank statement closing balance EUR 342,467.86 (DOC-0202), a gross difference of EUR 14,908.50. The February roll-forward was clean (GL and bank both opened at EUR 415,000.32), so the entire difference arose in March. Three causes were identified: a duplicated AP payment in the books, an unrecorded bank service charge, and a legitimate deposit in transit. A fourth item - an unidentified EUR 3,150.00 bank debit - could not be supported and has been flagged rather than booked.

2. RECONCILIATION AT 2026-03-31 (EUR)
  Balance per bank statement (DOC-0202)                     342,467.86
  Add: deposit in transit - Kessler AG RE-7090 (JE-00308)    18,200.00
  Add: unidentified bank debit not yet in the GL (BT-DE-0045) 3,150.00
  --------------------------------------------------------------------
  Adjusted balance                                          363,817.86
  Balance per GL 1000 after adjusting entries below         363,817.86
  Difference                                                      0.00

18 of the 19 March bank lines have been matched to ledger entries. The only unmatched bank line is BT-DE-0045; the only unmatched ledger cash item is JE-00308 (deposit in transit).

3. ITEMS CORRECTED IN THE BOOKS (with support)

a) Duplicate AP payment - Rheinbyte Software, EUR 6,480.00 - CORRECTED
   JE-00272 (posted 2026-03-18 17:00) and JE-00273 (posted 2026-03-19 08:02) both recorded payment of invoice RB-2026-0318 (DOC-0165, EUR 6,480.00, one invoice only) with identical lines (Dr 2000 / Cr 1000). The bank shows a single SEPA debit of EUR 6,480.00 on 2026-03-18 (BT-DE-0043). JE-00273 is a duplicate keying of the same disbursement and overstated both the AP relief and the cash outflow.
   Action: posted JE-00309, exact reversal of JE-00273, dated 2026-03-31 (Dr 1000 / Cr 2000 EUR 6,480.00). Support attached: DOC-0165, DOC-0202.
   Note: this also restores EUR 6,480.00 to the Rheinbyte AP balance, which was understated. No cash was actually paid twice, so no vendor refund is due.
   Policy check: EUR 6,480.00 at the 2026-03 policy rate of 1.10 USD/EUR (DOC-0204) = USD 7,128 - below the USD 10,000 senior-accountant posting limit, so no approval request was required.

b) Unrecorded bank service charge, EUR 38.50 - CORRECTED
   BT-DE-0053, 2026-03-31, "MONTHLY SERVICE CHARGE", never recorded in the GL.
   Action: posted JE-00310 dated 2026-03-31, Dr 6900 Bank Fees 38.50 / Cr 1000 Cash - Operating 38.50. Support attached: DOC-0202. Matched to BT-DE-0053.

4. ITEM CONFIRMED CORRECT - NO ENTRY REQUIRED

c) Deposit in transit - Kessler AG, EUR 18,200.00
   JE-00308 (2026-03-31, Dr 1000 / Cr 1100) records collection of invoice RE-7090 (DOC-0156). The remittance advice (DOC-0206) states the SEPA credit transfer was initiated 2026-03-31 after the bank cut-off, so it is correctly recorded in the GL in March and is a genuine deposit in transit at 03-31. I confirmed the amount ties to invoice RE-7090. No entry required; it should clear in the April statement and is the largest reconciling item to monitor.

5. ITEM FLAGGED - NOT BOOKED (EXC-001)

d) Unidentified SEPA debit, EUR 3,150.00
   BT-DE-0045, 2026-03-19, "SEPA OUT REF TX-44817". There is no corresponding journal entry, and a search of the document store returned no vendor bill, remittance, contract, or authorization referencing TX-44817 or the amount EUR 3,150.00. Because there is no evidence of what was purchased or who was paid, I cannot determine the offsetting account (expense vs. AP vs. employee advance vs. an erroneous/fraudulent debit), and under Policy 11 I have not posted a plug or a suspense entry to force the reconciliation.
   Action: logged as exception EXC-001 (EUR 3,150.00, related to BT-DE-0045 and DOC-0202).
   Recommended next steps: (i) obtain the full SEPA payment advice for TX-44817 from Treasury/the bank to identify the beneficiary; (ii) if it is a valid disbursement, record it in April to the correct account; (iii) if the beneficiary is unknown or unauthorized, initiate a SEPA recall/dispute with the bank immediately, as the 2026-03-19 value date is already outside the 13-month dispute window only far in the future but recall windows are short.
   Materiality: EUR 3,150 (approx. USD 3,465) is below the USD 10,000 posting threshold and, in my judgment, not material to the DE March financial statements; I do not believe it should hold up the close, but it must be cleared before April close.

6. NET EFFECT ON DE MARCH RESULTS
   Cash - Operating (1000):    +6,441.50 (357,376.36 -> 363,817.86)
   Accounts Payable (2000):    +6,480.00 (credit, liability restored)
   Bank Fees (6900):              +38.50 (expense)
   Net income impact:             -38.50

7. CONTROL OBSERVATION
   The duplicate AP payment was keyed to the ledger twice roughly 15 hours apart by ap.clerk with the same invoice number and the same support document. The AP subledger does not appear to block re-payment of an already-paid invoice number. I recommend a duplicate-invoice-number control in the AP workflow. Separately, the EUR 3,150 unidentified debit indicates a gap in the disbursement authorization trail for SEPA payments originated outside the AP module; recommend reviewing who has payment-origination rights on the DE operating account.

8. CHECKLIST STATUS
   DE "Bank reconciliations" has been set to in_progress, not complete. GL 1000 is fully reconciled (difference 0.00) subject to EXC-001, but (i) EXC-001 remains open pending bank documentation and (ii) the DE payroll account (GL 1010) reconciliation was outside the scope of this assignment and has not been performed. Please advise if you want GL 1000 signed off with EXC-001 as a carry-forward item.

Entries posted: JE-00309 (reversal of JE-00273), JE-00310 (bank fee). Exceptions logged: EXC-001.
